payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute Stirling numbers of the second kind via DP with 2D table: S(n,k)=k*S(n-1,k)+S(n-1,k-1), then O(1) lookup.
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly builds a 2D DP table up to n=800, with states (n, k) stored, and uses recurrence over both dimensions, matching dp_2d_state.
